subject: Evening reception & exec dinner — transport, menu, and sponsor signage
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacorp.com>, Novacorp Events <events@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evening reception & exec dinner — transport, menu, and sponsor signage

Hi Olivia / Novacorp team,

Thanks again for working with us on the evening reception and exec dinner the night of the workshop (Wed 20 May). We want to lock a few logistics today so our execs and sponsors have a smooth experience. High-level asks below — can you confirm availability/cost and any open questions?

1) Transportation
- We will need two small shuttles from The Garrison Hotel to The Conservatory: one departing 6:15 PM (VIPs + speakers) and a follow-up at 6:45 PM (guests). Please confirm vehicle size and driver contact.

2) Dinner timing & flow
- Cocktail reception 6:30–7:15 PM in the conservatory foyer (passed hors d'oeuvres + two cocktail stations).
- Seated dinner 7:30 PM (three-course plated) with short exec remarks at ~8:15 PM.

3) Menu & dietary restrictions
- We had a few requests (pescatarian x3, gluten-free x2, vegan x1). Can Chef Marco confirm suitable plated menu options and whether separate plated meals are possible without slowing service?

4) Sponsor signage and placement
- Novacorp is co-sponsoring: need sponsor logo banner (8ft x 3ft), two branded cocktail napkin runs, and a high-top with logo near registration. Please send specs for printing (file DPI, safe zone).

5) On-site point of contact and run of show
- We will assign an on-site Redwood lead; for now please share your on-site event manager and direct line. We'll share the attendee list and seating chart once final.

Attachments: catering_proposal_novacorp_v3.pdf (for reference)

Please reply with confirmations/changes and any pricing deltas. If it's easier, happy to hop on a 20-min call this afternoon.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Novacorp Events <events@novacorp.com>, Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening reception & exec dinner — transport, menu, and sponsor signage

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers below and a few clarifying Qs. Forwarding Chef Marco to confirm plated options.

1) Transportation
- We can provide two 14-person vans (with space for luggage / swag) — driver contact for both is Marco Alvarez, cell +1 (206) 555-0134. Cost: $420 total (both trips + wait time). Pick-up point at hotel valet; drivers will wear event lanyards and have a passenger manifest.

2) Dinner timing & flow
- Slotting looks good. We recommend a 10-minute buffer between cocktail close and dinner start to seat guests. We can provide two roaming cocktail servers during reception.

3) Menu & dietary restrictions
- Chef Marco suggests: starter (spring pea velouté or smoked salmon carpaccio), main (seared halibut with herb emulsion; roasted beet & quinoa stack for vegan option), dessert (lemon tart). He confirms separate plated meals are fine; kitchen can stage 6 special plates without delay.

4) Sponsor signage and placement
- Attached: sponsor-signage-specs.pdf with bleed/safe zone and preferred file types. For the 8x3 banner we need vector (EPS/PDF) or 300 DPI at full size. Printing + install for banner and napkins: $650. High-top table wrap (logo panel) available for $120.

5) On-site POC / Run of show
- On-site manager: Daniel Reed (daniel.reed@novacorp.com), cell +1 (206) 555-0180. He will have the master run and will coordinate signage placement with your team.

We are attaching the catering_proposal_novacorp_v3.pdf with line-item pricing and the sample menu. Let me know if you want us to print napkins with sponsor logo (need final logo by Tue noon).

Best,
Olivia
Operations Manager, Novacorp Events
ovia.park@novacorp.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening reception & exec dinner — transport, menu, and sponsor signage

Thanks Olivia — all sounds reasonable. Quick internal decisions from me so the vendor can lock:

- Menu: Confirm plated three-course as proposed by Chef Marco. Marcus approves the halibut as main; Monika (Monica) will collect dietary specifics and names.
- Transportation: Confirm the two 14-person vans at quoted price. Please add driver contact to run sheet.
- Sponsor collateral: We will provide high-res vector logos by Tue 11:00 AM. Please proceed with banner + napkins + high-top wrap as quoted.
- Seating: Attached is seating_chart_v2.xlsx (guest names redacted in this copy) — Monica will fill final seats by Tue end of day.

Monica — can you take point on dietary list and final seating? Vanessa — can you own sponsor point of contact on-site (photo of installed signage + napkin sample before guest arrival)?

If Novacorp needs a signed event sponsor addendum, please send; we'll run it through legal.

-Marcus
Director, Enterprise Sales
Marcus_lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Evening reception & exec dinner — transport, menu, and sponsor signage

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. Final confirmations:

- Vendor: Novacorp Events to proceed with plated menu & special-diet staging; Chef Marco to receive final dietary list from Monica by Tue 5 PM.
- Transport: Two vans, pickup 6:15 PM (VIP) and 6:45 PM (general), drivers Marco Alvarez and second driver (info in Daniel's run sheet). Cost approved.
- Signage: We'll deliver vector logos by Tue 11:00 AM; please confirm proof back by Tue 3 PM so printing can proceed.
- On-site POC: Daniel Reed (Novacorp) + Vanessa (Redwood) will do a quick install check 90 mins before cocktail service.
- Billing / Expense: Charge Redwood account EX-TRAVEL-2001; Marcus, please confirm if we route sponsor printing costs to the Novacorp sponsor invoice or Redwood pays upfront and invoices sponsor later.

Next steps: Monica to send the final seating & dietary list; Olivia/Daniel to confirm driver names on the run sheet and send proof of signage by Tue afternoon. If anything changes after proofs, call Vanessa at +1 (415) 555-0112.

See you on-site — thanks all.

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
